subject: RSQLite / rApache on a RHEL 5 system

messages.author: 64eed2ec3c5386ff
messages.subject: RSQLite / rApache on a RHEL 5 system
parts:
Hi,

My rApache script works well on a Debian 32bit system. Now I am trying
to move it to a RHEL5.6 64bit system. The system has been updated. The
R (2.14) was grabbed from EPEL, then rApache (1.1.16) and a few R
packages including RSQLite were installed. Everything works well,
except apache crashes once the code tries to connect a SQLite database
through RSQLite. The error message is similar to Rajarshi's (http://
groups.google.com/group/rapache/browse_thread/thread/
d93f304b642bbd73/1003a5fece3b6c90) (cannot post to that topic):

*** glibc detected *** /usr/sbin/httpd: free(): invalid pointer:
0x00002ab860fc0318 ***
======= Backtrace: =========
/lib64/libc.so.6[0x2ab8506a445f]
/lib64/libc.so.6(cfree+0x4b)[0x2ab8506a48bb]
/usr/lib64/R/library/RSQLite/libs/RSQLite.so(sqlite3_initialize+0x2b1)
[0x2ab86245d5b1]
/usr/lib64/R/library/RSQLite/libs/RSQLite.so[0x2ab862489a4d]
/usr/lib64/R/library/RSQLite/libs/RSQLite.so(RS_SQLite_newConnection
+0x11c)[0x2ab86244877c]
/usr/lib64/R/lib/libR.so[0x2ab85c0cd1d6]
/usr/lib64/R/lib/libR.so(Rf_eval+0x650)[0x2ab85c0fd650]
...

It is surprising that the same R code including SQLite database
connection and query part works in R shell, but not in rApache
environment. R shell and rApache should use the same RSQLite.so,
right? How can they behave differently?

I rebuilt the R from the source code, the rApache and R packages; also
updated the RHEL to 5.7. The problem still cannot be solved.

I suspected the SQLite was too old (3.3.6), so I installed a local
version 3.7.10, then compiled the RSQLite again. Still the same. I
also built a CentOS 5.6 system which should be identical to RHEL 5.6,
and it does has the same SQLite 3.3.6. Amazingly the code works in
rApache on this CentOS 5.6!

So there must be some problems in my RHEL5 box.

Any clues? Many thanks!

Qiang

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: RSQLite / rApache on a RHEL 5 system
parts:
Hi Qiang,

Can you print out the following environment variable both from your
command line R and from rApache?

Sys.getenv('LD_LIBRARY_PATH')

I wonder if indeed sqlite is finding different libraries.

Jeff

messages.author: 64eed2ec3c5386ff
messages.subject: Re: RSQLite / rApache on a RHEL 5 system
parts:
Hi Jeff,

From R: [1] "/usr/lib64/R/lib:/usr/local/lib64:/lib:/usr/lib"

And there is no such an variable from rApache (RApacheInfo). But on
that Debian system where the script works, this variable doesn't exist
either.

I tried to add the following sentence in the script, but it still
doesn't work.

Sys.setenv(LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/usr/lib64/R/lib:/usr/local/lib64:/lib:/
usr/lib')

Thanks!

Qiang

messages.subject: Re: RSQLite / rApache on a RHEL 5 system
parts:
For people who are also looking for the solution of the same problem,
I didn't figure out the exact reason. Instead, I removed the RSQLite
functions and just loaded the whole dataset in .RData binary format
into memory by REvalOnStartup. At least my program can run, and it is
not slow at all. :-)

Qiang
